speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of binucleated eosinophils in your urine indicates a drug-induced interstitial nephritis rather than a typical bacterial pyelonephritis. Did you experience any severe itching or hives in addition to the rash you developed after starting amoxicillin?

text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication.
